gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Distinctive up top: Unica One keeps every stroke one thickness. Mochiy Pop One, a sans-serif with letters hung like clothespins on a line, follows underneath with the same large lowercase eye.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Blunt and unmistakable: Unica One holds every stroke to a single thickness, with daylight inside each curve. Mochiy Pop P One leaves wide gaps between letters, and that openness is the pair's real hook.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mozilla-headline: Unica One gives its round letters walls as sturdy as its straight ones. Mozilla Headline, a sans-serif with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, keeps text approachable down the whole page.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-nata-sans: Commanding up top, Unica One keeps each stroke at a single thickness. Nata Sans adds curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths, and that steady technical-pen feel is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Unica One cuts its t with crossbar and stem sharing a single width, a stripped-down, commanding look. Noto Sans Arabic adds wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height, the pair's most telling quality.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Modern and stark, Unica One shows a stroke contrast of essentially zero across every curve. And Noto Sans Balinese, with breathing space in every curve and short ascenders, reads smoothly line after line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-batak: Marker-traced and blunt, Unica One draws each letter in one confident line, while Noto Sans Batak towers with its stubby x-height. Its wide-open e keeps paragraphs feeling friendly rather than squeezed.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase and mouths distinctly open, a quiet foil for Unica One's tube-like bends. Text moves along smoothly, with nothing shouting for attention.
